observedFailure: All follower nodes are behind the primary and repeatedly reject an authenticated replication response above the fixed 268435456-byte ceiling.
objective: Bound each suffix by bytes as well as block count so a follower can make authenticated forward progress without raising the decompressed response ceiling.
invariants: the active 256 MiB maximum remains enforced on fetch and apply
every batch retains base/end continuity and integrity verification
final state remains separately sealed and validated
the recovery tool may touch only the existing ynx-chaind binary and its release-manifest; it preserves units, environment, state and every other service
no public status changes occur before protected deployment acceptance
requiredEvidence: focused chain and daemon tests including oversized-history progress
race check for chain and daemon
node-only deployment-tool syntax and dry run
separate protected deployment acceptance before any remote mutation

localEvidence.tests: passed: go test ./internal/chain ./internal/api ./cmd/ynx-chaind; go build ./cmd/ynx-chaind; go test -race ./internal/chain ./cmd/ynx-chaind; make static-check; git diff --check
localEvidence.behavior: non-final replication suffixes select the largest HMAC-authenticated contiguous block range fitting the 64 MiB transport target; the 256 MiB fetch/apply ceiling and final-state seal are retained
localEvidence.releaseTool: scripts/ops/deploy-bounded-replication-recovery.sh passed bash -n and a four-node DEPLOY_DRY_RUN. It validates the exact package, binary and manifest digests, backs up only the current ynx-chaind binary per node, restores it when post-restart status fails, preserves units, state, environment and all other services, and requires a gate-bound full commit before a real mutation.

rollback: Revert the dedicated candidate commits. The node-only recovery tool creates a per-node copy of the preexisting binary before restart and restores it on a failed post-restart health check; keep the current production release untouched until a separate deployment gate accepts exact source and follower convergence.

preflight.detail: An earlier false blocker was corrected: /etc/ynx/ynx-chaind.env is intentionally systemd-readable rather than ordinary-SSH-user-readable. The tool now verifies it with sudo without reading or disclosing values. The four-node read-only preflight confirmed active service, expected binary, systemd-readable environment, archive tools and local status endpoint on each node.
